recs.x: One talk in particular in which he focuses on this idea, including with facts and figures from research literature, is a talk he gave a while ago called "Theorizing from Data": [link] . You should definitely watch it if you haven't seen it before.

However, it suffers the classic Google app problem; it does interesting stuff, but just looks ugly, and is generally unappealing. Hard for me to explain why, but despite my interest in the technology I just didn't enjoy using it at all.

But it is interesting stuff, I'd been wondering when something like this would emerge since watching this Norving talk from 2007 [ [link] ].
